title: Map
description: A battlefield: a character grid plus named markers and zones. One character per tile — '.' open, '1'/'2'/'3' cover levels (light/heavy/garrison), 'r' road, 'o' olive grove, 'n' rocky knoll, and any building symbol declared in data/structures.json. Authorable in a text editor on purpose: maps are the scatter-prop and sightline budget of a mission, and contributors should be able to sketch one without tooling. The loader (packages/data parseMap) additionally checks that row counts and lengths match the declared dimensions and that markers/zones are in bounds.

items.description: One character per tile. Terrain: "." open, "1"-"3" cover levels, "r" dirt road, "o" olive grove (cover 1), "n" rocky knoll (cover 2). Building symbols are whatever data/structures.json declares -- a contiguous run of identical building symbols is one structure. The pattern here is deliberately permissive: listing symbols in a regex meant they were hardcoded in three places at once, and validate_data.mjs now cross-checks every symbol against the structure catalogue and the terrain legend instead, so it cannot drift. A prior version of this pattern still hardcoded an alphanumeric-plus-# allowlist, which silently excluded punctuation symbols like the wall type's "=" -- the same drift the refactor was meant to prevent. Any single non-whitespace character is legal here; the catalogue and terrain legend are the only real authority on which ones mean something.

markers.description: Named points missions reference: spawn anchors, tunnel mouths, HVT positions.

zones.description: Named rects [x, y, w, h]: objective areas, trigger regions, no-fire zones.
